messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — Synapse Health POC kickoff tomorrow. Need a compact alignment thread on scope, success criteria, timeline, and who’s doing what. Main asks from them: 1) doc search + retrieval + rerank, 2) triage-guided suggestions for support agents, 3) abstractive summaries for long patient notes. Also they want a ballpark for dedicated capacity pricing during the POC.
Maria Patel: Proposed POC outline: 4 weeks. Week0: env & access + sample data ingest. Week1: baseline evals (accuracy, latency, token cost). Week2: perf tuning + quantization trials. Week3: acceptance tests + exec demo + handoff doc. Deliverables: eval report, prompt bank, cost/runbook, dashboard access.
Jamal Khan: SE coverage: I can lead week0 deep-dive (2 full days) and be on-call for tuning in week2. Need their sample prompts, expected SLOs (p95 latency), and a small prompt-eval set ~30 cases.
Tayla Singh: Infra checklist from our side: network diagram, IP allowlist, KMS method (customer-managed or ours), and certs for TLS termination. Also their security questionnaire flagged retention of logs and cross-region replication — need answers from legal/security.
Alex Chen: Success criteria suggestion (draft): 1) Retrieval precision@5 >= 0.78 on their eval set; 2) Avg assistant turnaround < 600ms p50 and < 1.5s p95 for 512 tokens; 3) Cost target: <= $X per 1k requests (we'll compute); 4) No PII leakage in sampled outputs. Thoughts?
Maria Patel: Those look good. Add "model degradation threshold" — if quality drops more than 6% vs baseline we fail. Also require 10 canned prompts for the demo and a signed TOU for sample data.
Jamal Khan: For prompts, here's a starter set I want them to provide (just paste into channel):
```
- Summarize note focusing on diagnosis + next steps
- Given patient history, suggest 3 follow-ups
- Extract medications and dosages from free text
```
SE Bot: Reminder — POC template v2 uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/poc-template-v2 (includes checklist for legal/security and runbook skeleton).
Tayla Singh: Security action items: customer to confirm SOC2, SAML provider details, and whether logs must be forwarded to their SIEM. Ask them to fill security questionnaire section A-C by EOD Thursday.
Alex Chen: Pricing: we can offer a short reserved capacity add-on for the POC (3 GPUs) with uplift — I’ll draft numbers but need expected token volume. If they’re <200k tokens/day we can do a lighter config.
Maria Patel: Timeline ask to customer: sample data + security questionnaire by Mon EOD, prompts + eval set by Wed, kickoff smoke tests Thu, full run Wed next week. Is that realistic?
Jamal Khan: Works for SE schedule. I’ll block week0: Mon/Tue deep-dive. Can do Friday demo prep.
Tayla Singh: Ops note — if they require private deployment we need 2 weeks lead for VPN & KMS integration. Call that out asap.
Alex Chen: OK — action list: 1) Maria to send timeline + deliverable list to customer (today) 2) Jamal to send prompt template + eval format (today) 3) Tayla to send infra questionnaire + required fields (today) 4) I’ll prepare POC pricing note and shared calendar invites.
Maria Patel: Sending to customer now. cc @Jamal Khan @Tayla Singh.
SRE Bot: Deploy alert: none. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: Great, thanks team. If customer asks about contract lead time escalate to legal.sales. :thumbsup:
